svg.title: Smart TTL freshness lifecycle
svg.desc: A brief is fresh for 30 days, then the chamber refuses to fire until an upgrade-and-enhancement pass is gated and promoted, resetting the clock.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: The clock is a gate, not a scheduler. It refuses; it never fetches.
